• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* IT \(due to limited AI exposure\), and broadly any sectors facing weak growth or high valuations\.
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(FIIs are likely to reduce exposure to India given its new status as Asia's least\-preferred market, driven by concerns over AI exposure, growth, and valuations\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Fund managers should evaluate overweight positions in Indian equities, particularly in sectors with high valuations or perceived limited AI integration, and potentially reallocate to more favored Asian markets\.
